text: Continuous Integration, or CI, is a common practice in modern software development. Developers regularly add their code changes to a shared repository. Each time they do this, automated builds start automatically. These builds compile the code and run tests to check that everything works correctly. The main goal is to catch issues early, before they become bigger problems. CI pipelines make this process smooth and reliable. They can build, test, and even deploy the software step by step. By using CI, teams save time, reduce mistakes, and deliver better software faster. It has become an essential part of professional development workflows today.
